'''sweigold Rancor like Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[sweigold]]
* '''Published:''' 21 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Vile sweigold DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My COTVG deck that is built with almost all pre-E1 cards.

== Strategy ==

After getting your hand, you look for a couple of things. If your opponent is giving you good activation, then you want to use the AC text to pull Jabba The hutt. If not, pull Chall, or Lyn if you get Boba in your opening hand. Just site on tatooine with a drain of two or so, and make ur opponent lose 1 per turn to your objective. Eventualy when the poor chap decides to come to Tatooine, you swing out some bounty hunters at him, and hidden weapons with a destiny of 2 captures Quigon. Then its Rancor time. Maul and Jade are in there just for beat-downs.
